results.title: Kurdish-led group in Syria says it has dissolved after merging with the army
results.description: The commander of the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces on Tuesday announced the official dissolution of the group, which once controlled a de facto autonomous zone in Syria's northeast.

results.title: The resurgence of Alaska news outlets | Talk of Alaska
results.description: Locally owned and operated news sites are popping up around Alaska, and these homegrown newsrooms are run by people who believe in the power of news — not just to inform but to bring communities together.
